guidance_source.scope: Possible causes and proposed investigation procedures; not the newly simulated findings or outcomes.

checks.check: Measure a known-good reference on the suspect setup and compare the supply configuration against the intended test configuration.
checks.result: The reference also reads below 35 mA. The applied force-voltage setting differs from the intended setting.

checks.check: Measure D006 and the reference on an independently verified setup using the intended configuration.
checks.result: D006 measures 44.60 mA and the reference measures 45.00 mA; both pass.

assessment: A supply-setup mismatch is a plausible explanation for the low-current readings on the original setup.
